subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this Feishu streaming-card fix after repair, or require redacted live Feishu/CardKit proof before merge?
rationale: The external contributor says they cannot access a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming deployment, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a visible channel change.

options.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
options.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.

options.title: Override After Maintainer Verification
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly own the proof gap if they verify the Feishu path through a sanctioned tenant or accept the channel-specific risk.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want this latest-token case handled together with the wider Feishu streaming-card reliability tracker.

recommendation.title: Require Repair Plus Proof
recommendation.body: Tighten the helper, rebase onto current main, and require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or a maintainer-run proof override before merge.
